There was so much to see, discover and be part of.

A huge thank you to everyon

World Percussion Workshop🪘

Kombumerri Traditional Owner, Lann Levinge, and Turkish musician, Atman, gave us an immersive cross-cultural music workshop that blended didgeridoo practice with world percussion traditions.

Arkestra Choir 🎼

A deep listening and creative performance by Fletcher Babb (Cold Ghost), Daniele Constance and a community of passionate Gold Coast artists and musicians.

Spot yourself? 📸

There's more photos of YOU at @six60 and @subtribemusic on our Facebook Page @bleachfestivalgc. 🤩

What a night with @six60 and @subtribemusic. 🫶

Our biggest audience yet at HOTA!

A 3-tonne block of melting ice, suspended from a crane, over Evandale Lake at HOTA.

THAW was an inspirational act of endurance from leading Australian physical theatre company Legs On The Wall.

What a way to make a splash! 🪼✨

From the mesmerising illuminated jellyfish by Dead Puppet Society to the jaw-dropping stunts from Jetpack Entertainment & Events, the finale was one for the books. 

A massive THANK YOU to everyone who came along, lit up the festival and made it so unforgettable.

A huge thank you to our incredible sponsor family for championing the arts and helping bring BLEACH Festival to life.

We're deeply grateful to @goldcoastairport, @redemont.legal, @griffithuniversity  and Playking Foundation for their support of creativity, culture and community on the Gold Coast.

And just like that, the tide rolls out on BLEACH Festival 2026! 

100 glowing jellyfish, live music, mesmerising illuminated puppets from the award-winning Dead Puppet Society, and a thrilling stunt performance from Jetpack Entertainment & Events. 

A magical celebration to wrap up an incredible fes

Light up your night with VOICES! 

Last chance to spin a tube and watch light, sound and music come to life in this interactive sculpture that celebrates connection, creativity and play.

Featuring the voices of the Sydney Philharmonia Choirs. By Pulsing Heart.

Last chance to experience BLEACH Festival at the HOTA Lake Precinct! 🌈

BEACON, Food Trucks, Live Music Stage & More! 
Make the most of your visit and capture those unforgettable moments before it’s gone! 📸 💫

簡単な設営と快適な居住性を両立させた、家族4人で広々と使える2ルームシェルターです。
　
初心者でも迷わず簡単に設営できる、シンプルな設計が特長。リビングと寝室が一体となっているため、設営が一度で済むうえ、寝室である吊り下げ式のインナールームを外せば大型シェルターとしても活用できます。

シェルターの全周には冷気の侵入を防ぐスカートが施されており、寒い季節にも快適な空間を提供します。

Expressing yourself freely and naturally, without self-consciousness, restraint, or fear of judgement.

This moment was captured on the dance floor at @wellfestnz in February. @sarah.menlove and I were offering a Somatic Dance, Shakti was in full flow!

No choreography.
No performance.

Someone came up to us after this dance and said they felt healed.

After one dance.

Healing doesn’t always have to be heavy.
Sometimes healing happens on the dance floor.

In a room full of strangers and friends.
Bare feet on the earth.
Bodies moving to the beat.

When we drop out of our heads and

Still reminiscing Wellfest ✨

The deep conversations, the love that filled the space, and the beautiful friends we made along the way. Feeling so grateful to have shared such special moments with incredible humans. 💛

How do you return to normal life after five days of magic?

Wellfest. WOWfest.

Five days of ceremony, music and connection.
Daily cacao. Saunas. Kirtan. Dancing.

Barefoot on the earth.
Living, breathing, singing and moving in community.

I was so immersed in the experience that I barely took any p

Maybe that’s the whole point…

that we came here to dance 🫶

We’re still dancing in our minds. ✨🌙

As the sun set, the whole landscape of Wellfest transformed.

The trees and earth began to glow.Fires were lit.Costumes got wilder.The music turned up just a little louder… and the dancing never stopped.

The Magic Nursery became a glowing beacon in the night —

This isn’t about performing.. 

It’s about letting my expressive self show up… even with the fear of what others might think.

But FUCK that 🫠 people will always have opinions.

What I do and create might not land for everyone.. and that’s OK. The moment I realize it doesn’t matter, everything shift

When the dancefloor feels like home 👣

Queenstown holds such a beautiful dance community and seeing so many familiar faces come together like that… it felt like one big pulse moving through the floor.

Watching that ripple come alive in the dance was pure magic 🤍

Playing B2B with @stephenblase for

Few clips from @wellfestnz over the weekend! 

The community in the South Island is so lovely and wholesome and we were absolutely blessed with the weather! There is something special about coming together to learn, play, eat together and dance together. 

They also love to throw down in the south s

Behind the scenes at Wellfest.

When a festival has so many beautiful things happening at once, capturing it all becomes a real challenge. Moments appear everywhere — and disappear just as fast.

That’s where a great crew makes the difference.

Huge appreciation for this team who jumped in with focu

There was something about Wellfest by day that’s hard to put into words… but we’ll try. ✨

First and foremost — it was the human connection.
People arrived exactly as they were. No masks. No performances. Just open hearts.
There was that feeling of being seen, heard, and loved in your wholeness — an

WHAT A TEAM!

Kochi & Kobe Dump 🪷 Finally, I went to Kochi, the land of Quagsire 🥹 After I spent some time strolling around the Monet pond and hunting for Quagsire manhole covers, I ended my Shikoku tour with a day trip to Kobe 👀 Over there I visited even more shrines and ate spciy mapo dofu 😛

Nagasaki & Saga Dump 🍈 Next part of my Kyushu trip is my 2 daytrips to Nagasaki and Saga prefectures 🎐 I wish I had a bit more time, but I enjoyed hunting for the fruit bus stops 🚏 The castella ice cream sandwich in Nagasaki was also perfect 🤤 And I went to (my first ever) Teamlabs in Saga 👀

Kumamoto Dump 🐴 Next stop on my Kyushu trip was Kumamoto prefecture’s Kusasenrigahama grassland 🌿 Arriving there felt like stepping into Pinterest ✨ The sunlight was vibrant, the grass was luscious & the horses were chillin’ 🥹 I also climbed Mt. Aso, one of Japan’s most active volcanoes, IN MF CONVE
